description: Inner-type lexicon for auth credentials stored as encrypted MST records. Each com.etzhayyim.auth.credential record is wrapped in an com.etzhayyim.encrypted.record envelope (XChaCha20-Poly1305 + Signal-wrapped per-recipient keys per ADR-2605181100) before being committed to the PDS. Plaintext NEVER lands on the MST. The D1 vertex_etzhayyim_auth_credential table is a kotoba-datomic-projection cache (ADR-2605231500) that the auth Worker rebuilds from these envelopes on demand. Per ADR-2605172000 + ADR-2605181100.

subject.description: DID this credential authenticates. Typically the actor / account DID.

kind.description: Credential kind. `passkey` = WebAuthn FIDO2; `oauthLink` = linked external IdP; `emailLink` = magic-link verifier; `smsOtp` = SMS one-time password.

passkey.description: Present iff kind == 'passkey'. WebAuthn credential record.

oauthLink.description: Present iff kind == 'oauthLink'. Linked external identity provider (Google / Microsoft / etc.).

emailLink.description: Present iff kind == 'emailLink'. Pending magic-link verifier.

smsOtp.description: Present iff kind == 'smsOtp'. SMS OTP verifier (short-lived).

revokedAt.description: Set when the credential is revoked. A tombstone envelope MUST also be emitted on the MST so projection consumers can prune.

signCount.description: Last-seen WebAuthn sign counter. Replay-resistance state.

transports.description: AuthenticatorTransport hints. usb / nfc / ble / internal / hybrid.

handle.description: User-presented handle bound to this credential at registration time.

email.description: Email asserted by the IdP at link time.

codeHash.description: SHA-256 of the magic-link code (hex). The plaintext code is mailed but never recorded.
